title: Compute a nearby valid syndrome even when its unknown valid component is arbitrary
statement: For y=s+f, s in im H arbitrary, |f|<=chi n, the algorithm computes shat in im H with shat+s=Hg and |g|<=K|f|. It computes shat, not the unknown small lift g. Upper metasyndrome delta4 y=delta4 f and lower B2 y=B2 f erase s. Local descent, small-cycle filling, dual binary coordinates and constant-size anchored-array inverses give the explicit source K_plus,K_minus,chi with K=max(K_plus,K_minus).
